description: Source code for the S3 path migration worker in Mattermost, handling batch processing of file paths for migration, job management, and error handling.

classes.name: S3PathMigrationWorker
classes.description: Worker class responsible for migrating S3 file paths in batches, managing job state, and handling errors.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new S3PathMigrationWorker instance with provided job server, store, and file backend.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker loop, processing jobs and handling stop signals.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker gracefully by signaling via channels.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on environment variable.

methods.name: getJobMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves integer metadata from a job's data map, with error handling.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Main method to process a migration job, including batch retrieval, path decoding, and job state updates.

methods.name: markAsComplete
methods.description: Marks the migration as complete in the system store.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Updates job progress to 100% and marks it as successful.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Sets an error state for the job with logging.
